component.name: WaveFlux
component.summary: Modern audio player with dynamic waveform navigation and lyrics

description.p: WaveFlux is a high-performance cross-platform audio player crafted in modern C++ and Qt 6 Quick / Kirigami. It offers high-precision audio rendering, synchronized lyrics display, interactive audio waveform visualization, and a 10-band graphic equalizer.

ul.li: Dynamic interactive waveform visualizer with A-B fragment looping
Synchronized LRC lyrics with auto-follow scrolling and local/online lookups
Comprehensive format support (FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, Opus, WAV, ALAC, DSD, tracker modules)
DSP processing engine: 10-band graphic EQ, ReplayGain, loudness compensation, crossfade, silence trimming
Full desktop integration with MPRIS 2.0 transport controls

description.p: WaveFlux 1.4.1 release with lyrics subsystem and expanded platform packaging.
